title: Abelotto
requirements: Creation of a precision-matched back accessory representing a secondary interlocking shell for a sword collection. The asset required custom texture restyling to fit a clean silver-and-black palette matching existing high-end cosmetic packages. Core work centered on geometry stabilization, eliminating visible seams, and preventing runtime clipping when combined with catalog elements.
achievements: Designed zero-tolerance interlocking geometry fits over default catalog models
Baked custom high-resolution silver metallic PBR textures for realistic reflectance
Packaged final files into a drag-and-drop format with full accessory placement testing scripts
